You can customize a number of features including: choosing the name, all the statistics, and also use the front camera to get your face on the card! 

Features
- 213 Nations
- Full Customization of the card
- More than twenty cards to chose from
- Add your personal photo using your front camera or camera roll*
- Share it on Facebook, Twitter, Flickr, Mail and much more!

*Camera and camera roll permissions are required to add your own pictures to the cards.
